summary: Backend fully validated (27/27 pytest cases PASSED) covering auth (with 401 enforcement), all 4 master CRUDs, seed counts (6 Own + 4 Rented vehicles, 11 PerTrip + 22 Overhead categories), trip create/list/update with computed pending_freight/trip_margin/trip_expense_total and denormalized vehicle_no/vehicle_type/driver_name, overhead create with category_name enrichment, daily P&L (accrual/cash/chips/overhead_breakdown with prorated EMIs), monthly P&L with corrected income = revenue + return_adj (received in memorandum, plus old_workbook_income_double_counted note), annual P&L Apr-Mar with 12 months, pending-freight ageing buckets, valid xlsx export, Excel import preview + idempotent commit. Frontend web preview loads: token injection via localStorage works, Today screen renders (net profit hero, accrual/cash toggle both work, all 4 chips visible), but a CRITICAL React infinite-loop error ('Maximum update depth exceeded') is thrown from app/_layout.tsx Gate() as soon as any navigation occurs (e.g., tapping FAB). This blocks the rest of the UI flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught Error: Maximum update depth exceeded. Triggered after Today screen loads when user interacts (FAB tap navigates to /trip/new). The useEffect [user, loading, segments, router] re-fires because useSegments() returns a new array reference each render and router.replace calls cause more segment changes. Blocks navigation to Add Trip, P&L, More and Masters screens.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reach trip form due to Gate infinite-loop crash after FAB tap

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:253

action_items: Fix Gate() infinite loop in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx: remove 'segments' and 'router' from the useEffect deps (or memoize inAuth); e.g. useEffect(..., [user, loading, segments[0]]). Router.replace should be guarded with the current path so it doesn't re-fire.
Migrate 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to 'boxShadow' (index.tsx FAB styles).
Find and remove props.pointerEvents usage, migrate to style.pointerEvents.

rca_of_issue: Maximum update depth error originates at Gate() line 16 in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx. useSegments() returns a fresh array reference every render; when placed in useEffect deps, the effect re-runs on every render. Any effect that mutates route state (router.replace) cascades further re-renders. To reproduce: 1) inject TESTTOKEN123 in localStorage, 2) navigate to /, 3) tap FAB -> app throws. Fix: change deps to [user, loading, segments[0]] and add a guard `if (segments[0] === 'login' && user) return;` type checks, or use a ref for last-navigated-target.
